#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    while (cin >> s) {
        cout << s[0];
        int flag = 0;
        for (size_t i = 1; i < s.size(); ++i) {
            if (flag == 0 && s[i] == 'a' && i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == 't') {
                cout << '@';
                flag = 1;
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
            if (i + 2 < s.size() && s[i] == 'd' && s[i + 1] == 'o' && s[i + 2] == 't') {
                cout << '.';
                i += 2;
                continue;
            }
            cout << s[i];
        }
        cout << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
